audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart rated Levels 3 and 4-5 as Teemo-favoured and Level 1 / Level 6 / First item as decided, contradicting both the packet chart and the whys[] prose already on the page (whys[2] 'zone him off CS', whys[3] 'any step-up suicidal', whys[4] "it's a wash", whys[5] 'neither side runs away').
audit.why: Heimerdinger's turrets are unaffected by Blinding Dart, so once two-three H-28 G Evolution Turrets are down (Levels 3-5) the nest owns the lane; at 6 and at first item both sides spike, which is a wash, not a Teemo lead.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Level 2 Skill, Level 3 Heimerdinger, Levels 4-5 Heimerdinger, Level 6 Skill, First item Skill, 2+ items Teemo.

audit.why: Spikes list Levels 2-3 (turret nest), Levels 4-5 (three charges + CH-3X Lightning Grenade), Level 6 (UPGRADE!!! super-turret vs his upgraded Noxious Trap access), and 2+ items (his shroom map control). All four entries exist and are accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to build MR against Teemo and to buy Mercury's Treads.
audit.why: Toxic Shot (E) is an on-hit poison applied by his basic attacks and it scales with his attack speed; Blinding Dart (Q, 7s) is his only magic-damage tool. Armour and Plated Steelcaps read the trade correctly, MR does not.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart blinds only your own autos — your turrets keep firing through it. His sustained damage is on-hit AD from Toxic Shot, so build armour and Plated Steelcaps, not MR.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Use Hextech Affinity' in wants.you[2] as a probable wrong ability name. Hextech Affinity is Heimerdinger's real passive.

edits.before: One turret + AA wins level 1 against almost everyone. Identify how Teemo contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One turret and no stun at level 1, and his Blinding Dart plus Toxic Shot poison win the pure poke trade — bank a charge and take CS.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Blinding Dart's cooldown.
edits.after: Liandry's Torment is your spike, but his Toxic Shot and shrooms match the poke — neither side pulls ahead.

edits.before: He blinds your turrets aren’t affected — build MR, zone. Heimerdinger wins the Blinding Dart cooldown windows.
edits.after: Blinding Dart blinds your autos, never your turrets — they keep firing. His damage is on-hit AD, so build armour.

edits.before: He blinds your turrets aren’t affected — build MR, zone.
edits.after: Blinding Dart blinds your autos, not turrets — build armour.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Liandry's Torment  (turret burn), then Rylai's Crystal Scepter; boots Mercury's Treads.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Liandry's Torment (turret burn), then Rylai's Crystal Scepter; boots Plated Steelcaps.

notes: Level chart was internally consistent between layers but contradicted the packet chart AND the whys[] prose on the same page; all five changed rows are proposed as full+content pairs with matching ratings. Itemization corrected from MR/Mercury's to armour/Plated Steelcaps because Toxic Shot is on-hit AD. packet.suspectNames flag on 'Hextech Affinity' is a false positive — that is Heimerdinger's real passive.
